title: Billing hooks: add integration test harness w/ production-like telemetry replay + goldens
author: Cole Summers
description: Context: We’ve been iterating on billing hooks and metering aggregation logic (rounding/streaming/retries) and we’ve repeatedly relied on ad-hoc query validation. This PR adds an integration test harness that replays a small set of sanitized, production-like telemetry samples through the billing hooks + aggregation path and asserts the billing-ready outputs match checked-in golden files. This gives us a deterministic, audit-friendly regression signal before we ship changes that can affect invoices. What’s included: (1) A replay runner that ingests telemetry NDJSON fixtures (sanitized) and feeds them through the same codepath used by the billing hooks/aggregator; (2) Golden snapshots for billing-ready aggregates and export rows for a curated set of scenarios (streaming partials, disconnects, retries, cache hits, and time boundary behavior); (3) A new CI job that runs on PRs touching billing/metering code and uploads diff artifacts when the golden comparison fails; (4) Docs on how to add new scenarios and how to update goldens (explicit opt-in). Notes: Fixtures are scrubbed (no prompts, API keys, or customer identifiers) and only retain fields needed to validate meters/dimensions (token counts, request outcomes, endpoint type, model alias, region, timestamps). The harness normalizes ordering + timestamps to keep goldens stable. Follow-ups: we should expand fixture coverage for Dedicated attribution and invoice_run_id wiring after the control plane contract is finalized.
commits: billing/itest: initial replay harness skeleton + CLI
billing/itest: add sanitized telemetry fixtures and scenario README
ci: add billing-hooks integration test job + artifact upload
billing/itest: wire harness into billing hooks pipeline and tighten assertions
implementation_notes: The harness replays telemetry events (NDJSON) into the billing hooks ingestion boundary (same interface used by the API gateway hooks) and then runs the aggregation/export step against an isolated sqlite-backed test store. Outputs are compared against goldens at two layers: (a) meter-level aggregates (tokens_in, tokens_out, tokens_cached, requests, embeddings/rerank units where present) keyed by (account_id_synthetic, workspace_id_synthetic, model_alias, region, endpoint_type, outcome, day); (b) billing export rows (line-item ready) including meter_version and aggregation window bounds. To keep goldens stable, the harness: sorts dimensions, normalizes timestamps to a fixed window, strips non-deterministic IDs, and uses explicit rounding rules from the aggregator. Updating goldens requires running `make billing-hooks-goldens` with `UPDATE_GOLDENS=1` and including a short rationale in the commit message; CI rejects golden updates unless the opt-in env var is set during generation (prevents accidental churn).
ci_details: New workflow step: `billing-hooks-integration` runs only when paths under `billing/` or `metering/` change (plus workflow changes). It runs the harness over ~2k events total (3 scenarios) to keep runtime <3 minutes. On failure, it uploads `billing_itest_expected.json`, `billing_itest_actual.json`, and a unified diff to the GitHub Actions artifacts for quick triage. A longer-running, higher-coverage replay is intentionally not included in PR CI yet; we can add a nightly job once we have a larger fixture set and clearer suppression rules for backfills.
